Good morning Chris,

Thanks for following up, and sorry you've had to chase this again.

I can see your RMA form came in on September 27 for the NerdOctaxe on order Shop····. What I can also see is that no return label has gone out to you yet, which is why you've heard nothing since. That one is on us, not you.

A colleague is picking this up today to get the prepaid return label issued to this address, along with the earlier NerdQaxe issue you mentioned, so both are handled together rather than in separate threads. Once the unit reaches the warehouse, processing takes up to 10 days.

One thing I should ask so there are no surprises later: was either unit ever overclocked or modified? Overclocked units fall outside warranty cover, so it helps to know up front.

Thanks for your patience with this, Chris.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
